<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How It Works</h3><a id="user-content-how-it-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How It Works" href="#how-it-works"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ol dir="auto">
<li><strong>Global Defaults</strong>: User-level settings provide your default preferences</li>
<li><strong>Project Override</strong>: Project-level settings override defaults for specific projects</li>
<li><strong>Directory-Specific</strong>: When you change directories, project settings are loaded automatically</li>
<li><strong>Fallback Logic</strong>: Project model → User default model → System default (<code>gemini-3-pro-preview</code>)</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">This means you can have different models for different projects while maintaining consistent global settings like your API key.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Using Other API Providers</h3><a id="user-content-using-other-api-providers" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Using Other API Providers" href="#using-other-api-providers"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

<li><strong>OpenAI</strong>: <code>https://api.openai.com/v1</code></li>
<li><strong>OpenRouter</strong>: <code>https://openrouter.ai/api/v1</code></li>
<li><strong>Groq</strong>: <code>https://api.groq.com/openai/v1</code></li>
</ul>

<p dir="auto">Super Agent CLI provides several interactive features to enhance your workflow:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Shell Mode</strong>: Press <code>shift+!</code> to toggle shell mode for direct command execution</li>
<li><strong>Agent Modes</strong>: Press <code>shift+tab</code> to cycle through modes (plan, code, debug)</li>
<li><strong>Command Palette</strong>: Press <code>ctrl+p</code> to open a quick command palette</li>
<li><strong>Auto-Edit Toggle</strong>: Press <code>ctrl+y</code> to toggle auto-edit mode</li>
<li><strong>Configurable Hotkeys</strong>: All hotkeys can be customized in settings</li>
<li><strong>File Mentions</strong>: Reference files using <code>@filename</code> in your prompts</li>
<li><strong>Folder Mentions</strong>: Reference entire folders using <code>@folder</code> in your prompts</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Headless Mode</h3><a id="user-content-headless-mode" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Headless Mode" href="#headless-mode"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

<p dir="auto">By default, Super Agent CLI allows up to 400 tool execution rounds to handle complex multi-step tasks. You can control this behavior:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Limit tool rounds for faster execution on simple tasks</span>
super-agent --max-tool-rounds 10 --prompt <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>show me the current directory<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Increase limit for very complex tasks (use with caution)</span>
super-agent --max-tool-rounds 1000 --prompt <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>comprehensive code refactoring<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>

<span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Works with all modes</span>
super-agent --max-tool-rounds 20  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Interactive mode</span>
super-agent git commit-and-push --max-tool-rounds 30  <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Git commands</span></pre><div class="zeroclipboard-container">
    <clipboard-copy aria-label="Copy code to clipboard" class="ClipboardButton btn btn-invisible js-clipboard-copy m-2 p-0 d-flex flex-justify-center flex-items-center" data-copy-feedback="Copied!" data-tooltip-direction="w" value="# Limit tool rounds for faster execution on simple tasks
super-agent --max-tool-rounds 10 --prompt "show me the current directory"

# Increase limit for very complex tasks (use with caution)

# Works with all modes
super-agent --max-tool-rounds 20  # Interactive mode
super-agent git commit-and-push --max-tool-rounds 30  # Git commands" tabindex="0" role="button">

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Web Interface Features</h4><a id="user-content-web-interface-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Web Interface Features" href="#web-interface-features"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The web interface offers:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Modern Browser-Based UI</strong>: Access the AI assistant through any modern web browser</li>
<li><strong>Real-Time Chat</strong>: Engage in conversational AI interactions with streaming responses</li>
<li><strong>File Explorer</strong>: Browse and manage project files visually</li>
<li><strong>Tool Visualization</strong>: See tools being used in real-time with detailed output</li>
<li><strong>Chat History</strong>: View and manage conversation history</li>
<li><strong>Responsive Design</strong>: Works seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices</li>
<li><strong>Multi-Session Support</strong>: Run multiple sessions simultaneously</li>
<li><strong>Persistent Connection</strong>: Maintains connection state across interactions</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">The web interface provides all the functionality of the TUI with the added convenience of a graphical interface, making it easier to visualize file operations, tool usage, and complex workflows.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h4 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Priority Order</h4><a id="user-content-priority-order" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Priority Order" href="#priority-order"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Super Agent will load custom instructions in the following priority order:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li><strong>Project-level files</strong> take highest priority</li>
<li><strong>Global files</strong> serve as fallback if no project instructions exist</li>
<li><strong>Individual files</strong> (<code>*.md</code>) are merged into a single instruction set</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">If multiple files exist, they are combined with project instructions taking precedence. If neither exists, Super Agent operates with its default behavior.</p>
<p dir="auto">The custom instructions are added to Super Agent's system prompt and influence its responses across all interactions in the respective context.</p>
